THE_HYPOTHESIS_ACTUALLY_UNDER_TEST.statement: D is not one construct with an unstable value. It is a FAMILY OF SUBSTRATE-SPECIFIC FORMULAS sharing a name, and on PyPI the formula is a function of the same release activity that defines U -- so the positive correlation there is INDUCED BY CONSTRUCTION rather than measured.

THE_HYPOTHESIS_ACTUALLY_UNDER_TEST.why_this_matters_more_than_a_normalisati: If the flip is definitional, no normalisation of D_dec fixes it, because the two D's were never comparable quantities. The remedy is a rule about what may be compared, not a transformation.

OBSERVED_BEFORE_THE_LOCK_AND_THEREFORE_N.note: These were computed BEFORE this specification was written. They are recorded as pre-flight observations and NO gate below scores them. Pre-registering something already seen would be theatre.

WHY_THE_PROPOSED_FIX_IS_NOT_WHAT_IS_TEST.and_a_prediction_of_that_mechanism_ALREA: Queue congestion is a DECODE-side story, so the flip should concentrate in D_dec. It does not. Measured before this lock and recorded below, BOTH hops flip.
WHY_THE_PROPOSED_FIX_IS_NOT_WHAT_IS_TEST.note_on_the_github_figure: The alarm quotes -0.4702. On the 866 non-imputed rows it is -0.4455. The difference is the 126 imputed rows, which carry tau_v = 30.00 exactly and should not contribute to a fidelity correlation. Both figures are negative and nothing here turns on which is used.
WHY_THE_PROPOSED_FIX_IS_NOT_WHAT_IS_TEST.the_proposal: Normalise D_dec by inbound demand (closed / total inbound), on the theory that GitHub popularity floods the issue queue and depresses decode fidelity, while PyPI scale reflects release maturity.
WHY_THE_PROPOSED_FIX_IS_NOT_WHAT_IS_TEST.why_it_is_BLOCKED_as_stated: The committed GitHub cohort (govphys_quadratic_results.csv) carries no inbound issue or PR counts -- its columns are repo, stratum, E, U, D_enc, D_dec, D, tau_v, tau_v_imputed, stars, archived. Demand normalisation is not computable from committed data and will NOT be substituted with a proxy.

anti_immunisation: No threshold may be changed after any measurement. The pre-lock observations are marked as such and score nothing. REFUTED, UNTESTABLE-HERE and BLOCKED stay distinct.

gates.bar: both files load with 540 and 866 rows, every column present, no NaN in any quantity used

|rho(U_versions, months_since_release)| >= 0.50. If release count and release recency are strongly coupled, then rho(U, D_enc) on PyPI follows from the DEFINITION of D_enc rather than from any fidelity being measured. If this comes in below 0.50 the definitional explanation FAILS and the sign flip stands as a substantive substrate difference.
EXCLUDED. rho(D_enc_pypi, months_since_release) = -1.0000 exactly, by algebra. Verified, not scored: a quantity that cannot come out otherwise is not evidence.

Substituting a D_enc that does NOT reference release timing -- D_dec_pin_clarity, the only other committed fidelity column -- must drop |rho(U, D_enc)| on PyPI by at least 0.20 from its 0.5869 baseline. This is what separates 'the formula induced it' from 'PyPI genuinely differs'. It CAN fail.

On PyPI, U is a raw COUNT of versions. Converting it to an INTENSITY -- versions per month of package age -- must be reported alongside, and |rho(U_intensity, D_enc)| is reported whether or not it helps. No threshold: this gate asserts the number is DISCLOSED, and it is met by reporting it.
with D shuffled within each substrate, |rho| must fall inside [0, 0.10] on both, over 2000 permutations at the 95th percentile
BLOCKED. The committed GitHub cohort has no inbound issue or PR counts. Not computable, and no proxy will be substituted.

UNTESTABLE-HERE. Diagnosing why two numbers disagree does not produce a construct that travels. Building one needs a single formula computed the same way on both substrates, and the committed files share no fidelity column.

model: Is D one construct? Diagnosing the standing sign alarm
one_line: The alarm says rho(U,D) has opposite SIGNS on two committed substrates (+0.5695 PyPI, -0.4702 GitHub) and therefore D is unstable. This tests a different explanation: that D was never ONE quantity, and that at least one of the two correlations is induced by how D was defined rather than measured.
simulator_rule: Both substrates are committed real files. Nothing is simulated and no proxy is substituted for a blocked quantity.
too_perfect_rule: An |rho| of exactly 1.0000 is an identity to be located, not a triumph. N3 declares one in advance.

what_a_pass_would_and_would_not_license.and_if_N2_or_N4_fails: Then the definitional explanation is wrong and the sign flip is a real substrate difference. The alarm stands exactly as written and Q1 remains domain-scoped on the same terms.
what_a_pass_would_and_would_not_license.would: That the PyPI half of the sign alarm is an artefact of how D_enc was defined there, and therefore that the alarm should be restated: D is a family of substrate-specific formulas, not one unstable quantity.
what_a_pass_would_and_would_not_license.would_NOT: That D is repaired. That E = U*D_enc*D_dec is restored to universal standing. That the GitHub negative correlation is explained -- it is not touched by any gate here.
